title: Remains
description:
Remains investigates the body through absence. Taking the form of a fossil-like fragment, this wearable evokes the trace of a structure that once supported and transformed the organism to which it belonged.

The piece suggests that evolution leaves behind material residues through which the history of a body can still be read.

Realised in 3D-printed elastic TPU, its flexible structure holds a tension between bodily softness and fossilised form.
